description: EA-10 review fixes (11e 17.01 MOVING MONSTERS AND VEHICLES is worded per model; its FAQ). Fixture ork11e_o34_active (P1 Orks from ork11e_codex_test, open field). SETUP-ONLY: the Mek from armies/recon_stomps.json (the 11e Codex: Orks import) joins the Ork army and is attached to the Mek Gunz by the real CharacterAttachmentManager.attach_character (its can_attach gate passes: the shipped Mek leads MEK GUNZ); Custodian Guard Sodality Gamma is lined up across the Mek Gunz's lane; Sodality Delta engages the Deff Dread with the three Killa Kans in a row behind it. Part 1 (player path): the Mek Gunz (VEHICLE) advances (Waaagh! free re-roll clicked: 5 + 5 = 10in) and a real drag takes it straight through the Custodians (17.01, EA-10), but a real click on 'End This Unit's Move' is refused — its unstaged INFANTRY Mek would be carried through the same enemy models and left engaged (03.01; 09.06 AFTER MOVING) — and nothing moves. 'Undo Model', a legal drag and End This Unit's Move then confirm, with the Mek carried by the Mek Gunz's delta. Part 2: the engaged Deff Dread (VEHICLE) falls back (Ordered Retreat) and a real drag takes it straight through a friendly Killa Kan (17.01 FAQ: on a move other than a normal / advance move a MONSTER/VEHICLE can be moved through friendly units), confirmed with End This Unit's Move. Before the fixes the first End This Unit's Move carried the Mek through the Custodians, and the Deff Dread's drop was refused with 'Cannot move through Monster or Vehicle models'.
